description: This file is a Perl script used for checking patches and source files for coding style, license compliance, and other quality metrics. It is part of the checkpatch.pl utility commonly used in kernel and open source project development for static analysis and code review automation.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Displays usage information and help message for the script.

methods.name: list_types
methods.description: Lists all message types found in the source code for classification.

methods.name: parse_email
methods.description: Parses an email address string into components (name, comment, address).

methods.name: format_email
methods.description: Formats name and address components into a standardized email string.

methods.name: reformat_email
methods.description: Reformats an email string into a standard format.

methods.name: which
methods.description: Locates an executable in the system's PATH.

methods.name: which_conf
methods.description: Locates a configuration file in predefined directories.

methods.name: expand_tabs
methods.description: Converts tabs in a string to spaces based on tabsize.

methods.name: copy_spacing
methods.description: Replaces tabs in a string with spaces.

methods.name: line_stats
methods.description: Calculates length and indentation of a line.

methods.name: sanitise_line_reset
methods.description: Resets sanitization state for comment parsing.

methods.name: sanitise_line
methods.description: Sanitizes a line by removing comments and fixing formatting marks.

methods.name: get_quoted_string
methods.description: Extracts quoted strings from a line.

methods.name: ctx_statement_block
methods.description: Extracts a statement block with context around code conditions.

methods.name: statement_lines
methods.description: Determines the number of lines in a code statement.

methods.name: statement_rawlines
methods.description: Counts raw lines in a statement.

methods.name: statement_block_size
methods.description: Calculates size of a statement block.

methods.name: ctx_statement_full
methods.description: Gets full statement including nested blocks.

methods.name: ctx_block_get
methods.description: Recursively retrieves a block of code based on nesting.

methods.name: ctx_block_outer
methods.description: Retrieves outermost block around a code segment.

methods.name: ctx_block
methods.description: Retrieves inner block of code at nesting level.

methods.name: ctx_statement
methods.description: Retrieves a statement at a certain nesting level.

methods.name: ctx_block_level
methods.description: Gets nesting level of a block.

methods.name: ctx_statement_level
methods.description: Gets nesting level of a statement.

methods.name: ctx_locate_comment
methods.description: Locates comments associated with code blocks.

methods.name: ctx_has_comment
methods.description: Determines if a code block has an associated comment.

methods.name: raw_line
methods.description: Returns the raw source line for a given line number.

methods.name: get_stat_real
methods.description: Retrieves full source code statement including multiple lines.

methods.name: get_stat_here
methods.description: Gets a portion of source code around a specific point.

methods.name: cat_vet
methods.description: Encodes a string into a visible representation for vetting.

methods.name: annotate_reset
methods.description: Resets annotation state for code analysis.

methods.name: annotate_values
methods.description: Performs detailed annotation of code tokens for style checking.

methods.name: show_type
methods.description: Determines if a message type should be shown based on filters.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays a message report with color coding and optional formatting.

methods.name: report_dump
methods.description: Outputs accumulated report messages.

methods.name: fixup_current_range
methods.description: Adjusts line ranges in diff patches after modification.

methods.name: fix_inserted_deleted_lines
methods.description: Applies line insertions and deletions in patches.

methods.name: fix_insert_line
methods.description: Marks a line for insertion in a patch.

methods.name: fix_delete_line
methods.description: Marks a line for deletion in a patch.

methods.name: ERROR
methods.description: Logs an error message and updates error count.

methods.name: WARN
methods.description: Logs a warning message and updates warning count.

methods.name: CHK
methods.description: Logs a check message and updates check count.

methods.name: check_absolute_file
methods.description: Checks if an absolute filename points to a valid file within the tree.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from start and end of a string.

methods.name: ltrim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the start of the string.

methods.name: rtrim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the end of the string.

methods.name: string_find_replace
methods.description: Performs string substitution.

methods.name: tabify
methods.description: Converts leading spaces to tabs according to tabsize.

methods.name: pos_last_openparen
methods.description: Finds position of last unmatched open parenthesis.

methods.name: get_raw_comment
methods.description: Extracts raw comment text from a line.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main function for processing a patch or source file for style issues.
